cta_summary: The only call to action is a small underlined 'click here now' at the very bottom, after five paragraphs of preamble.

findings.message: The subject-line-sized headline stacks three classic filter triggers: all-caps urgency, triple exclamation marks, and a money guarantee.
findings.remedy: Rewrite as a plain-language promise of what the reader gets.

findings.message: 'RISK-FREE', 'no-obligation', 'once-in-a-lifetime' and 'Limited time only' in one paragraph read as promotional boilerplate to both filters and readers.
findings.remedy: Keep one specific claim and cut the rest.

findings.message: The action sits below four paragraphs of personal preamble, well past the fold - most readers will never reach it.
findings.remedy: Move the link above the fold, directly under the opening line.

findings.message: 'click here now' is 13px underlined text in the same color as body copy - it does not read as a button.
findings.remedy: Give it a filled background, larger type, and label it with the outcome.
